content:
Kai T.: quick heads-up — PR #13421 (kv-cache tweak) is ready but CI keeps failing on windows render-snapshot (shard-7). local mac/linux ok. holding merge, need approvals and next steps.
Priya S.: I can give an eyeball. do you have the snapshot diff? if it's just font/antialiasing noise, we can rerun the shard instead of snapshot update.
Kai T.: pasted diff below:
```
--- a/test/snapshots/render_windows.png
+++ b/test/snapshots/render_windows.png
@@ visual diff @@
- small rendering offset on toolbar icons
+ 1px shift / font hinting difference
```
Sam W.: that looks like the classic font fallback flake on windows VMs. not caused by kv change. targeted rerun should be safe. :thumbsup:
Ashley M.: quick note — we're limiting targeted reruns when queue is busy. if rerun fails twice, we'll ask for snapshot regen + PR description explaining flake.
ci-bot: targeted rerun requested for shard-7 by Kai T. queued (pos 4). estimated start ~ 10m.
Jordan L.: if it keeps failing, consider forcing deterministic font in the test or relaxing the pixel tolerance. but agree: rerun first.
Priya S.: I'll provisionally approve pending green. @Sam W. can you give a quick +1 after the rerun? 
Sam W.: will do. if green, approve and merge window is open until 6pm PST.
Kai T.: thanks — kicked the rerun. I'll ping here when green or if it fails twice.
ci-bot: rerun started on shard-7.
ci-bot: rerun completed — shard-7: PASS ✅
Priya S.: nice — approving now. +1 from me.
Sam W.: +1
Ashley M.: approved. merging when CI status propagates. please add a short note in PR about transient windows flake for future reference.
Kai T.: will do, thanks all! :rocket:
